_how: An effect is drawn in the WORLD at about a tile across and is laid over a lit stone floor, so: no ground, no shadow, no actor holding it, and the thing itself is the only light in the frame.
_inks: Storm greys and near-black, with the game's own lightning gold (--citrine #D9A441) and a white core. A bolt is the one saturated ink.
how: A single EFFECT: ONE thing centred and filling the frame, seen straight from the side, BOLD readable silhouette with a hard dark outline, chunky shapes and few colours, lit only by itself. Transparent background. NOT a scene, NOT a landscape, NOT a character, NOT a hand holding it, NOT a ground shadow, NOT text, NOT a border, NOT a frame, NOT multiple objects.

_sweep: A centred radial EFFECT is the one ask this generator would not take. Five variants of the melee sweep came back a beaded wreath, a saw blade, a clock face, a directional cut and a closed sunburst: 'arranged around an empty middle, seen from directly above' is a decorative RING to it, whatever it is told not to draw. The sweep stays procedural, and `sweepRing` breaks its ring on purpose because a closed hoop reads as a shield. Do not spend another generation on it without a genuinely different framing.
